# C Driver - (current)

> Explore resources for using the MongoDB C Driver, including installation, connection setup, data operations, and more.

- [Aggregation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/aggregation.md): Learn how to use the C driver to perform aggregation operations.
- [Async C Driver: Public Preview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/async-c-driver.md)
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect.md): Learn how to use the C Driver to connect to MongoDB by creating a MongoDB Client with read/write settings, security options and other connection settings.
- [Specify Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect/connection-options.md): Explore MongoDB C Driver connection options, including network, authentication, retry, and timeout settings configurable by using connection string or URI.
- [Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect/connection-options/connection-pools.md)
- [Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md)
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect/connection-targets.md)
- [Create a MongoClient](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/connect/mongoclient.md)
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud.md)
- [Bulk Write Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/bulk-write.md)
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/delete.md)
- [Store Large Files](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/gridfs.md)
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/insert.md): Learn how to use the C Driver to write data to MongoDB using methods such as insert, replace, update, delete, bulk writes, and transactions.
- [Read Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations.md): Learn how to use the C Driver to read data from MongoDB and specify options for reading data, including specifying fields to return or documents to return.
- [Count Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/count.md)
- [Access Data From a Cursor](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/cursors.md)
- [Retrieve Distinct Field Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/distinct.md)
- [Find Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/find.md)
- [Specify Fields To Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/project.md)
- [Specify a Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/specify-a-query.md)
- [Specify Documents to Return](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/query-operations/specify-documents-to-return.md)
- [Configure CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/read-write-configuration.md)
- [Replace Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/replace.md)
- [Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/transactions.md)
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/crud/update.md)
- [Data Formats](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/data-formats.md)
- [BSON](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/data-formats/bson.md): Learn how to create, modify, write, and read BSON documents using the C Driver.
- [Work with Extended JSON Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/data-formats/extended-json.md): Learn how to create, modify, write, and read BSON documents using the C Driver.
- [Serialization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/data-formats/serialization.md)
- [Time Series Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/data-formats/time-series.md)
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/databases-collections.md)
- [Get Started with the C Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/get-started.md): Learn how to create an app to connect to MongoDB deployment by using the C driver.
- [MongoDB C Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/index.md): Explore resources for using the MongoDB C Driver, including installation, connection setup, data operations, and more.
- [Optimize Queries by Using Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/indexes-EXAMPLES TO MOVE.md): Learn how to use indexes by using the MongoDB C driver.
- [Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/indexes.md): Learn how to use indexes with the MongoDB C Driver to improve efficiency, and explore different index types like single field, compound, and geospatial.

- [Logging and Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/logging-monitoring.md)
- [Monitor Data Changes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/logging-monitoring/change-streams.md)
- [Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/logging-monitoring/cluster-monitoring.md)
- [Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/logging-monitoring/logging.md): Learn how to configure structured logging with the MongoDB C Driver to observe application activities with different levels of detail.
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/mongodb-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Search in the C driver.
- [Run a MongoDB Vector Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/mongodb-vector-search.md): Learn how to use the C driver to perform MongoDB Vector Search queries.

- [Run a Database Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/run-command.md): Learn how to use the MongoDB C Driver to run a database command, specify command options, and perform a variety of administrative and diagnostic tasks.
- [Secure Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/security.md): Learn how to use the C driver to secure your data through authentication mechanisms, such as SCRAM-SHA-256 or MONGODB-AWS, and enterprise authentication.
- [Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/security/authentication.md)
- [Enterprise Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/security/enterprise-authentication.md)
- [In-Use Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c/c-driver/current/security/in-use-encryption.md)
